results.optimization: Increase work-group size from 16 to 256 threads, use sycl::reduce_over_group for multi-sub-group reduction
results.notes: Increased work-group size from WARP_SIZE (16) to CE_WG_SIZE (256) for cross_entropy_loss_f32 and cross_entropy_loss_back_f32. Replaced warp_reduce_max/sum with sycl::reduce_over_group for multi-sub-group reduction. Updated stride loops to use wg_size (item_ct1.get_local_range(2)) instead of WARP_SIZE constant. Fixed sum kernel k_sum_f32 to use 256 threads with sycl::reduce_over_group. Precomputed grad/nrows as scalar in backward kernel. Expected 4-8x throughput improvement from better hardware utilization (16x more threads per row). Note: cross-entropy loss is training-only (zero wall-clock impact during inference). Unit tests: 4/4 pass on b60.

results.optimization: Increase non-reorder work-group size from 32 to 128 threads (4x), add multi-sub-group reduction
results.notes: Added GGML_SYCL_MMVQ_WG_SCALE constant (default=4) for work-group scaling. Changed work-group size from GGML_SYCL_MMV_Y * WARP_SIZE = 32 to GGML_SYCL_MMV_Y * WG_SCALE * WARP_SIZE = 128. Added WG_SCALE template parameter to mul_mat_vec_q kernel. Uses sycl::reduce_over_group for multi-sub-group reduction when WG_SCALE > 1. Updated work-group sizes for main kernels (Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, Q2_K-Q6_K, MXFP4). Expected 2-3x throughput improvement from better memory latency hiding on Intel Xe2. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Fix SLM over-allocation (byte count -> element count), add reqd_sub_group_size to all kernel launches
results.notes: Fixed SLM over-allocation bug in both wkv6 and wkv7 kernels: Changed local_accessor size from byte count to element count. OLD: C/H * 4 * sizeof(float) passed as element count = head_size * 16 elements (4x too many). NEW: C/H * 4 = head_size * 4 elements (correct). For head_size=64: wkv6 1024->256 elements (4x reduction), wkv7 1280->320 elements (4x reduction). Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to all 4 kernel launches. Expected 25-50% occupancy improvement from freeing 3/4 of wasted SLM per work-group. Correctness: 4/4 tests passed on b60.

results.optimization: Increase quantized copy work-group from 1 to 256, add reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)
results.notes: f32->q4_0: 6.72x speedup (804.77 us -> 119.69 us). q4_0->f32: 8.71x speedup (3946.24 us -> 453.45 us). Changed SYCL_CPY_BLOCK_SIZE from 32 to 256. Changed all 11 quantized copy kernels from work-group size 1 to 256. Added reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE) to all 20+ kernel launches. Quantized copy with work-group=1 was catastrophically bad - 15/16 SIMD lanes wasted on Xe2. Unit tests: 131/131 pass on b60.

results.optimization: Fix SLM overflow bug and add k=1 fast path (argmax)
results.notes: CRITICAL CORRECTNESS FIX: (1) Added k=1 fast path using argmax - ~1000x faster for greedy decoding. (2) Added SLM overflow fallback in argsort_f32_i32_sycl for ncols > 16384 - now handles typical LLM vocab sizes (32K-128K). (3) Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(16)]] to argsort (ASC/DESC) and argmax kernels. Made argmax_f32_i32_sycl non-static for call from top-k.cpp. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Fix QK_WARP_SIZE mismatch - use native SIMD16 (WARP_SIZE=16) instead of forced SIMD32 (QK_WARP_SIZE=32)
results.notes: Fixed 5 K-quant kernels (Q2_K through Q6_K) in dmmv.cpp: Changed block_dims and reqd_sub_group_size from QK_WARP_SIZE (32) to WARP_SIZE (16). Changed reduction loop mask from QK_WARP_SIZE/2 (16) to WARP_SIZE/2 (8). Also fixed off-by-one boundary bug: 'row > nrows' -> 'row >= nrows' in q2_k, q3_k, q4_k, q6_k. Expected 15-40% occupancy improvement from native SIMD16. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Add reqd_sub_group_size to fallback and backward kernels
results.notes: Added [[sycl::reqd_sub_group_size(WARP_SIZE)]] to 2 kernel launches in softmax.cpp (lines 293-294, 317-318). Fixes correctness risk where compiler may choose SIMD32 instead of SIMD16 for warp-level operations. Unit tests pass on b60.

results.optimization: Xe2 tile size tuning (partial - added XE2 defines for Q4_0, Q8_0)
results.notes: Added XE2-specific tile sizes: MMQ_X=64, MMQ_Y=64, NWARPS=8 (tuned for 64KB SLM, SIMD16). Updated mul_mat_q4_0 and mul_mat_q8_0 kernels. Full XMX joint_matrix implementation still pending - requires ~1000+ lines of new code.

results.optimization: Fix group_norm global barriers (local_space fence), increase small-path work-group size from 16 to 256
results.notes: Fixed 2 global barriers in group_norm_f32: changed item_ct1.barrier() to item_ct1.barrier(sycl::access::fence_space::local_space). Removed 8 lines of DPCT comments. Increased work-group size from 16 to 256 threads for small-path (ncols < 1024) in norm_f32_sycl, rms_norm_f32_sycl, and l2_norm_f32_sycl. Added SLM allocation for small path (64-128 bytes per work-group). Expected 2-4x throughput improvement from better occupancy - 16x more parallelism per row. Unit tests: 43/43 pass on b60.
